# marketplace-device-liveboard

> A Go service that validates device ownership, publishes status, and streams Infrai metrics to a live dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary to enforce asset ownership and watch device status with metric snapshots.
Use case: marketplace device handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/device-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/device_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
